<article about="/adaptive-identity-access-management" class="page full clearfix" data-history-node-id="33981" role="article" typeof="schema:WebPage">
<span class="hidden" content="Adaptive Identity Access Management" property="schema:name"></span>
<div class="content">
<div class="field field--name-field-paragraphs field--type-entity-reference-revisions field--label-hidden field--items">
<div class="field--item"> <div class="paragraph-wrapper sc-color-10">
<div class="paragraph-image-left-bg paragraph paragraph--type--image-left-bg paragraph--view-mode--horizontal">
<div class="container mobler">
<div class="row">
<div class="paragraph-inner">
<div class="paragraph-left col-xs-12 col-md-6">
<h2 class="paragraph-title visible-xs visible-sm">
            Better Security and Better Business. Choose Both.
      </h2>
<div class="paragraph-image sc-color-7">
<div class="field field--name-field-image field--type-image field--label-hidden field--items">
<div class="field--item"> <img alt="Better security" class="img-responsive lazyloaded" data-src="https://www.secureauth.com/sites/default/files/paragraphs/2019-10/3_1b.gif" height="467" src="https://www.secureauth.com/sites/default/files/paragraphs/2019-10/3_1b.gif" title="Better security" typeof="foaf:Image" width="700"/>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="paragraph-body visible-xs visible-sm">
<div class="field field--name-field-body field--type-text-long field--label-hidden field--item"><p>Welcome to SecureAuth. The secure identity company.</p>
<p><span><span><span><span>You no longer have to choose between sophisticated security and user convenience.</span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span><span><span>When SecureAuth pioneered smart authentication for companies with complex environments, we had one goal: <em>Transform security into a business-enabler as opposed to a source of friction. </em></span></span></span></span></p></div>
</div>
<div class="paragraph-link visible-xs visible-sm">
<a class="btn btn-default" href="/products/identity-platform/adaptive-authentication">NO MORE DISRUPTIONS</a>
</div>
</div>
<div class="paragraph-right col-xs-12 col-md-6 visible-md visible-lg">
<div class="paragraph-right-inner">
<h2 class="paragraph-title">
            Better Security and Better Business. Choose Both.
      </h2>
<div class="paragraph-body">
<div class="field field--name-field-body field--type-text-long field--label-hidden field--item"><p>Welcome to SecureAuth. The secure identity company.</p>
<p><span><span><span><span>You no longer have to choose between sophisticated security and user convenience.</span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span><span><span>When SecureAuth pioneered smart authentication for companies with complex environments, we had one goal: <em>Transform security into a business-enabler as opposed to a source of friction. </em></span></span></span></span></p></div>
</div>
<div class="paragraph-link">
<a class="btn btn-default" href="/products/identity-platform/adaptive-authentication">NO MORE DISRUPTIONS</a>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="paragraph-image-right-bg paragraph paragraph--type--image-right-bg paragraph--view-mode--horizontal">

<div class="paragraph-inner">
<div class="paragraph-left col-xs-12 col-md-6 visible-md visible-lg">
<div class="paragraph-left-inner">
<h2 class="paragraph-title">
            Invisible Security
      </h2>
<div class="paragraph-body">
<div class="field field--name-field-body field--type-text-long field--label-hidden field--item"><p><span><span><span><span>Invisible security means that your users won’t need passwords. Plus, our multiple <em>risk-layer checks</em>—the most in the marketplace—run quietly in the background, not making their presence known… unless something’s suspicious. </span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span><span><strong><em><span>And our software can even improve the security of your existing identity management solutions. That’s how “Rip and Replace” becomes “Include and Improve”.</span></em></strong></span></span></span></p></div>
</div>

</div>

      </h4>
<div class="paragraph-body">
<div class="field field--name-field-body field--type-text-long field--label-hidden field--item"><p>With cyber attackers increasingly bypassing MFA, it’s time to better protect your workforce and customer identities and secure the access control gap.</p></div>
